## Fortnite Cosmetics Browser by 248Tech

Browse every Fortnite cosmetic and today's Item Shop on Windows. Free, open source, no Epic login.

**Download:** `FortniteCosmeticsBrowser.exe` below (portable, no installer). The zip has the same exe plus the license.
**Try it in your browser:** https://248tech.github.io/fortnite-cosmetics-browser/

> The exe isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. It's built from this tag by GitHub Actions.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/248Tech/fortnite-cosmetics-browser/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for details.
